name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly after a career in private security. While managing security for a high-profile event near Spa-Francorchamps, he impressed a McLaren team member with his meticulous planning and calm demeanor under pressure. This led to an offer to join the team, initially focusing on logistics and access control at race weekends. Over the years, he's risen through the ranks, becoming known for his proactive approach to threat assessment and his ability to build strong relationships with local authorities at each venue. 

Jean-Pierre's philosophy is simple: prevention is paramount. He emphasizes thorough risk analysis and clear communication to ensure the safety of the team and assets. He's not afraid to challenge established procedures and is constantly seeking innovative ways to improve security protocols. His loyalty to McLaren is absolute, and he takes immense pride in ensuring the team can focus on racing without security concerns.

physical.description: A stocky man with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with security checklists.
Has a habit of speaking in acronyms and security jargon, even in casual conversations.
Insists on personally checking every security camera feed at least once a day.
